Class LuaScriptContainer

Namespace
Cobilas.GodotEngine.Lua
Assembly
com.cobilas.godot.lua.dll

Represents an in-memory Lua script container that can be built from strings or builders.

public sealed class LuaScriptContainer : LuaScript, IDisposable

Remarks

This class provides a way to execute Lua scripts from code strings, StringBuilder, or LuaScriptContainerBuilder instances without requiring external files.
